owner_acceptance.context: The owner requested correction of all amplifier knob designs using original hardware references, after discussing incomplete Studio One and whole-product validation, then explicitly requested release and update when the corrections are complete.
owner_acceptance.scope: Corrected Chimera 1.3.1 open beta, retaining the disclosed unexecuted validation inventory. Publication requires exact-source native CI, installer and package evidence; no stable or complete-validation claim.
